reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly linking Al-driven B2 ordering to property changes, but it overstates the role of configurational entropy in stabilizing the disordered matrix and glosses over the well-known embrittlement risk of B2 phases at intermediate temperatures.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, but the falsification criterion is too broad; a lack of correlation could be due to many factors, and the hypothesis would be more decisively falsified if ordered precipitates formed without any property improvement.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful as it targets a central, actively researched mechanism in this alloy system and proposes a direct, comparative experimental path to isolate the effect of Al-induced ordering on multiple key properties.
